title: Your Pineapple Is Digesting Your Mouth
caption:
Pineapple isn't just a snack, it's eating you back.
A stick figure takes a huge juicy bite, then angry cartoon pineapples attack his tongue.
Pineapple's bromelain enzyme breaks down proteins, so it literally digests your mouth as you eat.
Do you soak pineapple in salt water first?
Save this before your next juicy battle!
